title: The dup-research plant lands inside the other agent's claim on a loaded host, not on a 5 s hold
goal: the dup-research plant orders its two agents (the second writes only after the first holds the claim, and the first releases only after the second has committed) instead of a fixed PLANT_HOLD, so multi fitness does not fail on timing
